addendum_hash_recipe.note: Recompute from this committed file alone; depends on every field except addendum_hash.

disclosure.cause: The index that resolves a record_id to its committed prediction hash scanned prereg/*/*.json and took the FIRST match in PATH order, keeping the earliest by directory name. Directory names sort historical < poolwatch < recorded < solana < xrpl < xrpl-mc, so 'recorded' - which holds OUTCOMES - sorted ahead of solana, xrpl and xrpl-mc, and won for any record_id it mentioned. Only xrpl outcomes had resolved in sufficient volume for this to appear.
disclosure.chains_that_would_have_inherited_it: solana and xrpl-mc both sort after 'recorded' and would have developed the identical defect as their outcomes accumulated. XRPL-MC's first graded batch resolves after 2026-08-11. The fix landed 2026-08-06, BEFORE that exposure.
disclosure.fix: The index now uses an explicit WHITELIST of pre-registration chain directories rather than scanning everything. A blacklist of 'recorded' would have fixed the instance and left the class open: 'disclosures' sorts before 'historical', so this very addendum would otherwise have stolen the anchor for every record_id it cites. Anchoring is additionally keyed on the manifest's created_utc rather than its path, which moved zero anchors on live data and removes a dependency on directory names happening to sort in emission order.
disclosure.header: scope: xrpl | found 2026-08-05 while auditing outcome linkage during an unrelated poolwatch investigation | fixed 2026-08-06
disclosure.immutability: Published manifests are never rewritten. The 256 mis-citations STAND AS PUBLISHED and cannot be repaired. The fix governs future citations only. No number in this addendum should be read as history having been corrected.

scale.growth_note: Growing daily - 13 to 73 over five days - not static.
scale.latent_note: 89 record_ids had a recorded-manifest anchor; 73 had been cited in a published outcome by the time of the fix. The other 16 would have been cited as their outcomes resolved.

disclosure.summary: 256 published outcome links cite a prediction hash whose earliest occurrence is a recorded (outcome) manifest rather than a pre-registration manifest. The citation is circular: the artifact pointed at as the 'committed prediction' is one that already contained the outcome.

verified_after_fix_INDEX_ONLY.scope_note: These figures describe the ANCHOR INDEX going forward. They do NOT describe the published artifacts: the 256 mis-citations already in recorded manifests are immutable and are repaired by none of this.

disclosure.what_is_NOT_wrong: ZERO outcome links cite a hash that exists nowhere. Every one of the 73 affected record_ids IS genuinely pre-registered in an xrpl pre-registration manifest, and that pre-registration is independently verifiable from the public repository. No outcome is linked to nothing, and no prediction is missing. What is wrong is the CITATION: it points a verifier at the wrong artifact.

outcomes_known_at_issue: All 73 cited predictions are resolved; this concerns how their outcomes CITE their predictions, not whether the predictions existed.
